transcript.text: dryer drum wont turn but i can here it running, hotpiont. clothes just sit there

When a Hotpoint tumble dryer motor runs but the drum doesn't move, the most common cause is that the drive belt has snapped or slipped off. This means the motor is working, but it isn't connected to the drum anymore. To check this safely:
1. Unplug the dryer.
2. Turn the drum by hand. 3. Tell me if it spins freely with no resistance (suggesting a broken belt), feels stiff or stuck (suggesting an obstruction or seized bearing), or is very hard to turn.
ok unplugged it and turned the drum by hand and it spins really easy almost no resistance

That suggests the drive belt has likely snapped or slipped off. To get you the correct replacement part, I need the model number from the rating plate inside the door opening. If you can't find that right now, let me know and we can try a different approach.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
its a hotpoint TVHM8 something the rest of the sticker is worn off so cant read it. i can take the back panel off with a screwdriver if that helps

That suggests the drive belt is likely broken or has slipped off. Since you are happy to remove the back panel, please unplug the dryer and take the screws out of the rear cover. Look inside at the motor pulley and the large drum: if the belt is missing, snapped in two, or just hanging loose, that is your fault. Also check for a small plastic arm (the tensioner) near the motor to see if it has broken. If you can see the belt is gone or broken, I can tell you what part to order next.
ok took the back off, i can see a black rubbery strip lying at the bottom, not on the pulley. is that the belt? i heard a twang then a thud yesterday

[Heading: Likely cause: drive belt]
Yes, that is the drive belt. To fix this, you will need a replacement drive belt for your Hotpoint tumble dryer. Because the model number on your rating plate is incomplete (TVHM8...), I cannot confirm the exact part number to ensure it fits correctly. Using the wrong size belt can cause damage or fire risks. I recommend finding the full model number from the sticker inside the door frame and ordering the correct belt from a reputable spare parts supplier, or calling an engineer who can identify the right part on site.
the sticker inside the door is worn off too so i only have TVHM8. is there any other way to work out which belt i need, like measuring it or something

[Heading: Likely cause: drive belt]
Measuring it yourself is not reliable because dryer belts vary significantly in length and width even within the same brand; using the wrong size could cause it to slip or snap again, creating a fire hazard. The most useful outcome here is for an engineer to visit: they can confirm the part number on site and fit the correct replacement belt for you.
